name: Physics-Informed DeepONet
summary: Train DeepONet solution operators using differential-equation and boundary-condition constraints.
core_idea: Apply physics-based residual penalties across varying input functions to bias an operator network toward PDE-consistent outputs.
innovation: Reduces dependence on paired forward-solver labels compared with purely supervised operator learning.
limitations: Residual weighting and optimization can remain difficult.
Generalization depends on the distribution of input functions and constraints.

start_here.why: Seminal physics-informed DeepONet construction and equation-driven examples.
start_here.focus: Physical residual losses applied across input-function samples.

curation_note: Scholarly source and method contribution checked; starting references are suggestions, not mandatory reading.
